headline: Clayton beats Humphries to win the Swiss Darts Trophy in Basel
standfirst: Jonny Clayton won European Tour 14, beating Luke Humphries 8-4 in a final where each player averaged over 101.
body: Jonny Clayton won the Swiss Darts Trophy at the St. Jakobshalle in Basel, beating Luke Humphries 8-4 in the final. The averages were almost identical, 101.68 for Clayton and 101.75 for Humphries, but Clayton won the important legs.

Clayton was in excellent form all weekend. He averaged 108.81 against Maik Kuivenhoven in the last 32, then beat Rob Cross 6-4 and Karel Sedlacek 6-2. In the semi-finals he averaged 105.00 to beat Gian van Veen 7-4 and hit a 161 checkout, the best of the event.

Humphries produced the highest average of the tournament, 111.17, in his 7-4 semi-final win over Mensur Suljovic. Suljovic averaged 100.55 in that match after beating Dirk van Duijvenbode 6-1 in the quarter-finals.
Sedlacek hit the most maximums, 22, ahead of Clayton on 21 and Tom Bissell on 19. There were 388 maximums across the event.
